Meet Metheney's Auto Repair

Expert auto repair in Grove City

Metheney's Auto Repair is a local auto repair shop located on N Liberty Rd in Grove City, PA. The shop offers a range of services from auto repair and welding to specific repairs like rust and rocker panels.

With frame repair as a core service, Metheney's handles the structural work too: rust repair, rocker panels, and welding in aluminum and stainless.
